- Chat intent router is pure/no-I/O 5-branch classifier — single deterministic routing for both owner-ai and public-chat paths
- Proof ledger forbids claim words (done/deployed/fixed/verified/live) without full proof attached; missing fields force finalStatus=UNVERIFIED
